descriptionChirho: Midian (Hebrew מִדְיָן), the proper name referring to (1) the son of Abraham and Keturah (Gen 25:2, 4; 1 Chr 1:32-33), (2) the Arabian tribal people descended from him, and (3) the territory they inhabited east of the Jordan and south of Moab. Appears with various prepositions (in Midian, Exod 2:15; 4:19; against Midian, Judg 8:1; from Midian, 1 Kgs 11:18; as/like Midian, Ps 83:9) and conjunctions (and Midian, Judg 7:12; 1 Chr 1:32), all of which are syntactic variants of the same proper noun. Uniformly rendered Midian/Madian/مِدْيَان/미디안/मिद्यान across all target languages with 59 total occurrences.
